impacts.description: Advances in model architecture, memory, reasoning, and autonomous behaviour are paving the way to unlocking AI agent potential across economic sectors, contributing to the Apply AI Strategy.
Contribution to the Apply AI Strategy through deployment of AI agent results via European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIHs) and validation in Testing and Experiment Facilities.
Strengthening European open strategic autonomy in digital and emerging enabling technologies through next-generation AI agent research.
impacts.inference_note: The call destination is explicitly stated as 'Achieving open strategic autonomy in digital and emerging enabling technologies (2026-27)'. The technological autonomy impact is directly derivable from this destination statement and the topic's focus on next-generation AI agents.

impacts.description: Sharing of communicable results with the European R&D community through the AI-on-demand platform, advancing scientific knowledge dissemination.
Real-world applications of AI agents in healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving sectors, delivering societal and industrial benefit.
